data_fields.name: max_draw_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: none (the donor has no far plane in its box test)

best_idea: Cull whole groups of entities with one box test per chunk (hidden: skip all; fully visible: skip per-entity tests; partial: test each entity), then sort the survivors far to near.
decision_why: The three-way chunk test is a cheap win for prop and NPC crowds on phones; Frankendom must add a draw-distance cap (the donor has none), sort once across all chunks (the donor sorts only inside a chunk), and replace the linear lookups per entity.
acceptance: In a zone with 300 entities over 9 chunks, a 375 px frame draws zero entities from a chunk behind the camera (asserted by the draw-list count), and billboards in the draw list are in far-to-near order across chunk borders.
